name: POST /api/dialer/campaigns/:campaign_id/start - Start a campaign
description: Moves a draft campaign to running; the dispatcher then works its contacts. (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC1). Lifecycle: draft -start-> running <-pause/resume-> paused; draft|running|paused -cancel-> cancelled (terminal). Repeating the action that produced the current status is a no-op. The agent must be outbound or both, published and not kill-switched. The runner's agent is an unpublished draft, so testCases[0] exercises that refusal; starting a published agent's campaign is proven end-to-end. Every status change emits voice.campaign.progressed.v1 {campaign_id, agent_id, status, trigger, total, by_status} (95b9060e-9695-45f9-a970-323d68d6a444#AC2 — campaign progress is emitted as voice.campaign.progressed.v1); contact uploads emit it at most once per DIALER_PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS (default 5 s) per campaign.

testCases.name: Refuse to start a campaign whose agent has no published version
Start a campaign of a published agent

errorCases.message: cannot start a campaign that is <status>
errorCases.when: the campaign is cancelled or completed

errorCases.message: the agent is inbound-only and cannot place outbound calls | the agent has no published version | the agent's kill switch is engaged
errorCases.when: the campaign's agent cannot place calls
